targetText:
But successive shipments of commodities can start their passage
at shorter intervals of time and thus reach the market one after another
without accumulating in large quantities as potential commodity-capital
before actual shipment.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in The Time of Circulation: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText:
A similar effect is produced in various branches of business by
the more or less prolonged periods in which rather large quantities of
raw material are thrown on the market.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
